NOTIFY_UNMUTED: Your voice is no longer muted.
NOTIFY_RADIO_REVOKED: You left a frequency your job no longer allows.
COMMAND_MUTE: Mute or unmute a player's voice
COMMAND_DEBUG: Print the voice state to the server console
ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: Voice ranges, the radio and phone calls.
ADMIN_C_BACKEND_DESC: FiveM Legacy talks through Mumble; FiveM for GTAV Enhanced through server voice channels.
ADMIN_H_BACKEND: Automatic picks the server voice channels when the server has them (Enhanced), else Mumble. A change applies when ai-voice starts again.
ADMIN_C_RANGES_DESC: How far a player is heard. Players switch between these ranges with the voice range key.
ADMIN_H_MODE_DISTANCE: How far this range carries, in metres.
ADMIN_H_DEFAULT_MODE: The position in the list a player starts with (1 = the first range).
ADMIN_H_CYCLE: Off keeps everyone at the starting range (scripts can still change it).
ADMIN_H_RANGE_FACTOR: FiveM Legacy only: players within the range times this number receive the voice (Mumble's native audio fades out over a longer distance than the range). 3 is pma-voice's value.
ADMIN_C_RADIO_DESC: Players on the same frequency hear each other anywhere while the radio key is held.
ADMIN_H_VOLUME: How loud others sound, in percent; players can change it for themselves.
ADMIN_H_MAX_CHANNELS: How many frequencies a player can listen to at the same time; they talk on one of them.
ADMIN_H_SUBMIX: Filters the voice like a speaker. The game has a small fixed number of sound effects and cannot remove one: switching this off stops using the effect, players free its slot only by restarting the game. On FiveM Enhanced this needs setr sv_mumble true.
ADMIN_H_PHONE_SUBMIX: Filters call voices like a phone. Switch it off when your phone script brings its own call effect (lb-phone with CallEffects is not detected). Players free the effect's slot only by restarting the game. On FiveM Enhanced this needs setr sv_mumble true.
ADMIN_H_EFFECT_BY: A running script that brings its own effect: ai-voice's effect stays off while it runs.
ADMIN_H_MIC_CLICKS: A click when someone starts and stops talking on the radio; players can turn it off for themselves.
ADMIN_H_SYNC_NAMES: Radio scripts that list members get each member's character name.
ADMIN_C_ANIM_DESC: What the character does while talking on the radio. Job frequencies can pick their own animation.
ADMIN_H_RADIO_ANIM: Off: no animation on any frequency. Scripts can also turn it off for one player.
ADMIN_H_ANIM_SET: Used on every frequency without its own animation.
ADMIN_H_ANIM_FLAG: TaskPlayAnim flag: 49 = upper body, loops, can walk; 50 = upper body, holds the last frame, can walk.
ADMIN_C_PHONE_DESC: Players in the same call hear each other anywhere.
ADMIN_H_CLIENT_CALLS: Off (safe): only server scripts put players into calls, or a phone script that checks each join. On: any player could join any call; needed by phones that join calls from the player's game, such as lb-phone.
ADMIN_H_SPEAKER: Phone scripts can turn a call's loudspeaker on: players standing next to the phone hear the other side.
ADMIN_H_SPEAKER_RADIUS: Players within this many metres of the phone hear the call.
ADMIN_F_SPEAKER_TWO_WAY: The call hears the people around
ADMIN_H_SPEAKER_TWO_WAY: The other side of the call also hears the players standing next to the phone.
ADMIN_TAB_CHANNELS_DESC: Radio frequencies only some jobs can join, and their animation.
ADMIN_C_CHANNEL_DESC: Every frequency from the first to the last number follows these rules.
ADMIN_H_CHANNEL_RANGE: Frequencies as the radio shows them, for example 1 to 10 or 1.5.
ADMIN_H_CHANNEL_JOBS: Only members of these jobs can join; a player who loses the job or goes off duty leaves at once. Empty: everyone.
ADMIN_H_CHANNEL_DUTY: The player must be on duty for one of the jobs.
ADMIN_H_CHANNEL_ANIM: The radio animation on these frequencies (the default one, none, or a set).
ADMIN_ERR_CHANNEL_RANGE: The first frequency must not be higher than the last.
